answer: Saturn has 293 confirmed moons as of June 2026. This represents a dramatic increase from previous counts, with 128 new moons discovered in March 2025 and 11 additional moons confirmed in March 2026 by the International Astronomical Union's Minor Planet Center. Saturn now has more confirmed moons than any other planet in the Solar System.
